title: AgentDoc Historical Source ACL Snapshot
description: Immutable historical ACL provenance retained with source-derived assertions. This envelope is never current authorization evidence: it supplies the immutable observation instant and governing policy version from which freshness is computed, but expiry, connector availability, and effective access are evaluated separately by Cloud at evaluation_time. snapshot_id, workspace_id, connector_id, source_container_id, source, acl_policy_version, and observed_at must match the corresponding current ACL evidence and decision resource fields that cite this snapshot. These equalities are evaluator-owned and fail closed.

workspace_id.description: Workspace in which this snapshot was observed. It must match the workspace on current ACL evidence that names this snapshot; equality is evaluator-owned and fails closed.

source_container_id.description: Provider-owned parent container for the bare source resource id, or the provider-owned tenant or account identifier when no intermediate container exists. It must match current ACL evidence and resource.source_container_id on a decision that cites this snapshot; equality is evaluator-owned and fails closed.

acl_policy_version.description: Connector ACL policy version active when this historical snapshot was observed.

source.description: Exact source resource with a bare source-local id; parent container context is carried separately by source_container_id.

observed_at.description: Observation instant participating in the cross-envelope join defined by this schema's object description. The schema pins the lexical RFC 3339 shape; calendar validity and instant comparison are evaluator-owned and fail closed.

nonEmpty.description: Single-line opaque identifier or version string.
